proposals.evidence: The source prints Zargari čhal 'shadow' and explicitly compares Early Romani učhal > čal while discussing merger of aspirates and voiced affricates (p. 127 §2.3.1). Turner 2542 *ōjjhalla 'shade, screen, veil' cites European Romani učhal and Welsh Romani učal 'shade', probably from *avacchāda-. Turner 763 also indexes those same Romani comparanda under the deeper *avacchāda-; 2542 is the nearer formation for this inherited stem. The source's čh is retained. Original PDF, glyph-decoded source audit and imported key checked; no transcription or identity change.

proposals.evidence: The source explicitly prints the additive deš- compounds for 11–16 together in its cardinal-number table (p. 137 §3.5.1). Their first member is source deś 'ten', already linked to Turner 6227, which directly gives European Romani deš. The second member is the separately installed source numeral, already linked to its own specific Turner branch. These are synchronic components of a Zargari numeral, not proposed reflexes of the Sanskrit fused teen numerals. For 11, source jek is the installed yek variant with a compiled rank-1 edge to source yekʰ, already linked to Turner 2462 §2. Original PDF, glyph-decoded source audit and imported key checked; no transcription or identity change.
